now.title: The Defenders#8
now.text: Misty joins the battle against the Hand at Midland Circle, fighting at the Defenders' side.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An NYPD detective who fights beside the Defenders while watching them.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Defender Misty fights beside while keeping an eye on them for the NYPD.

proposed.text: While Jessica fights in the cavern beneath Midland Circle, Misty breaks into the building to help Colleen and Claire against Bakuto, and loses her arm to his sword.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An NYPD detective who covers for the Defenders and loses her arm fighting the Hand.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Defender Misty covers for at Midland Circle.

changes.evidence: The Defenders #8: Misty fights Bakuto upstairs with Colleen and Claire and loses her right arm; Jessica, Matt and Luke are down in the cavern. Misty never fights beside Jessica, and she lies to Strieber for them rather than watching them for the NYPD.

now.title: The Defenders#7
now.text: Detective Misty Knight works alongside Matt and the other Defenders during the fight against the Hand.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A detective who fights the Hand alongside the Defenders.
now.on_b_card_about_a: One of the Defenders Misty works with against the Hand.

proposed.text: Misty Knight questions Matt and the other Defenders about the Hand at the precinct, then agrees at Midland Circle to stall the police while they go after Danny.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A detective who questions Matt, then stalls the police for the Defenders.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: One of the Defenders Misty questions, then covers for at Midland Circle.

changes.evidence: The Defenders #7: Misty interrogates Matt at the 29th Precinct; at Midland Circle she only agrees to stall the NYPD. She does not fight the Hand until #8, and then upstairs against Bakuto, not with Matt.

now.title: The Defenders#5
now.text: When the Hand holds the Defenders at the Royal Dragon, Stick helps them break free from Murakami's grasp.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An old foe who helps the Defenders break free of Murakami's grasp.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The hidden power behind Nobu in the Hand.

proposed.text: When Murakami and the Hand ambush the Defenders at the Royal Dragon, Stick fights beside them and leads them out through the sewers.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An old foe who leads the Defenders out of Murakami's ambush.

changes.evidence: The Defenders #5: Murakami ambushes from the roof and fights Danny and Matt, then is knocked out by Elektra; Gao's men restrain Danny until Jessica shoves Gao aside, and Stick opens the drain so the group escapes. Nobody is in 'Murakami's grasp'.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: Yori Nakajima is Bucky Barnes' neighbor and lunch companion in Brooklyn. He does not know that Bucky killed his son as the Winter Soldier, until Bucky finally confesses.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's Brooklyn neighbor and lunch friend, whose son Bucky killed as the Winter Soldier.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Yori's neighbor and lunch companion. Finally confesses to killing Yori's son.

proposed.text: Yori Nakajima is Bucky Barnes' neighbor and lunch companion in Brooklyn. He does not know that Bucky killed his son as the Winter Soldier.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Yori's neighbor and lunch companion, who hides that he killed Yori's son.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6
split.text: Bucky finally tells Yori the truth: as the Winter Soldier, he killed Yori's son.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's Brooklyn neighbor, to whom he confesses killing his son.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Yori's neighbor, who confesses to killing Yori's son as the Winter Soldier.

changes.evidence: The stage starts at episode 1 (lunch, Bucky sees the son's photo on the shrine), but Bucky's confession to Yori happens in episode 6 'One World, One People'.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: Sam Wilson fights Georges Batroc during a hostage rescue over Tunisia. They clash again after Batroc joins the Flag Smashers.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Fights Batroc over Tunisia, and again with the Flag Smashers.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Mercenary Sam fights over Tunisia, who later joins the Flag Smashers.

proposed.text: Sam Wilson fights Georges Batroc during a hostage rescue over Tunisia.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A mercenary Sam fights over Tunisia.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6
split.text: Batroc, now fighting for the Flag Smashers, attacks Sam at the GRC building in New York, and Sam breaks off the fight to stop a hijacked helicopter.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Fights Batroc over Tunisia, and again in New York when Batroc fights for the Flag Smashers.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A mercenary Sam fights over Tunisia, and again for the Flag Smashers in New York.

changes.evidence: Episode 1 'New World Order': Tunisia rescue, Sam forces Batroc down. Karli hires Batroc only at the end of episode 5, and Batroc attacks Sam at the GRC in episode 6 'One World, One People'.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: Karli once worked for the Power Broker before stealing the Super Soldier Serum for the Flag Smashers. Sharon sends Batroc to spy on her, and during the fight in New York, Sharon kills her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who has Karli spied on, then kills her in New York.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The serum thief Sharon has spied on, then kills in New York.

proposed.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6

changes.evidence: Sharon never meets Karli before episode 6: there Sharon (revealed as the Power Broker) offers Karli work again, Batroc deduces he was hired to spy on Karli, and Sharon shoots Karli. The stage sits at the start of the show (episode 1, where Sharon is not even present) and tells all of this.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: Sarah is Sam Wilson's sister. They fight to save their parents' fishing boat in Louisiana, and she backs him when he takes up the shield.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's sister. Backs him when he takes the shield.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Sarah's brother. Fights with her to save the family boat.

proposed.text: Sarah is Sam Wilson's sister. They fight to save their parents' fishing boat in Louisiana.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's sister, fighting with him to save the family boat.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#5
split.text: Sarah tells Sam she has always been proud of him and urges him not to let Isaiah's words decide whether he takes up the shield.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's sister, who backs him in taking up the shield.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Sarah's brother, whom she urges to make his own choice about the shield.

changes.evidence: Episode 1: Sarah and Sam try to save the family boat (loan denied). Sarah backs Sam on becoming Captain America in episode 5 'Truth', telling him she has always been proud of him and not to let Isaiah Bradley's words deter him.

now.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
now.text: Years after Galactus is defeated, Victor von Doom visits young Franklin and unmasks himself before him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Visits Franklin years later and unmasks before him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The young boy Doom visits and unmasks for, years after Galactus.

proposed.text: Four years after Galactus is defeated, a cloaked man sits with young Franklin and removes his metal mask before him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The young boy the cloaked man visits and unmasks for, years after Galactus.

changes.evidence: Mid-credits scene: the man in a green cloak is never named on screen; Wikipedia notes he is identified as Victor von Doom only off-screen. The text and a card name 'Victor von Doom' / 'Doom'.

now.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
now.text: Years after Galactus is defeated, Sue finds Victor von Doom sitting with her son Franklin.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Found by Sue sitting with her son Franklin.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Franklin's mother. Finds Doom sitting with her son.

proposed.text: Four years after Galactus is defeated, Sue returns to find a cloaked man sitting with her son Franklin.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Franklin's mother, who finds the cloaked man sitting with her son.

changes.evidence: Mid-credits scene: Sue returns with a book to find a man in a green cloak holding a metal mask with Franklin; he is identified as Doom only off-screen, never named on screen.
